notes: The belonging לְ is the clause's predicate and takes the construction-supplied copula together with the *of* written for its own relation (rule 49); because a preposition of its own is written, rule 49's fused genitive case does not reach it.
The article on תְּשׁוּעָה is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing *victory* with no *the* (rule 29).
The margin's *Or, deliverance* was read and set aside; the printed *victory* governs (rule 38).
